inspirations.name: muninndb
inspirations.description: MuninnDB server — Go binary with REST/SSE/MCP APIs that this extension connects to

localEnhancements.description: Add /muninn-test command with fast mode (16 REST tests) and full mode (49 tests covering all 39 MCP tools via HTTP JSON-RPC)
Fix /muninn-dream env loading — read ~/.muninn/muninn.env before running dream protocol
Add PrimeCodex standards: .primecodex.json catalog metadata, .upstream.json provenance tracking, CHANGELOG.md
Full README rewrite for @gaodes/pi-muninndb identity, commands, test documentation, and architecture

Refactor setup flow: remove Docker/Podman container fallback, direct binary download with SHA-256 verification, and container port checks. Replace with official MuninnDB install script (install.sh / install.ps1). Binary search now includes ~/.local/bin/muninn.

Add v1.5.0 semantic memory improvements: prime-settings.json configuration engine, context-aware SSE semantic triggers with evolving per-turn context, guide surfacing on first connect, health liveness self-checks, and mindset-oriented save guidance.

updates.description: Refactor setup: remove Docker/Podman fallback, direct binary download with SHA-256 verification, and container ports. Replace with official MuninnDB install script (muninndb.com/install.sh or install.ps1). Update README, CHANGELOG, and tests accordingly.

Release v1.5.0: context-aware semantic triggers, session-evolving subscription context, prime-settings.json config engine, muninndb_muninn_guide surfacing, health liveness self-checks, and mindset-oriented save guidance.
